main_text.head: DISPOSITIONUM ORATORIARUM. In GENERE DEMONSTRATIVO.
PARS I.
I.
LAUS PERSONÆ CONSTANTINI MAGNI.
main_text.p: Xord. A simili ab architecto, qui magnum ædificium moliens egregium jacit fundamentum. Ita Deus magna moliens excitat viros magnos. Illustretur exemplis, & novissimè Constantini Magni.
Propos. Hujus herois vitam & facta prædicanda.
main_text.l: I. Genus & majores. Pater Constantini Chlorus, imperio clarus, avus Eutropius, Romanorum nobilissimus: Mater Helena, pietate insignis. Illustretur ex loco communi: Fortes creantur fortibus & bonis.

II. Præmisso loco communi de matura manifestatione virtutis, prædicet Ætate primam & indolem generosam exactâ sub Galerio, adolescens Sarmatas stravit, capto duce. Ex invidia cum Leone certare jussus a Galerio vicit, & fugit ad patrem in Gallias. Illustretur loco communi de invidia comite virtutis.
III. Res gestas juxta genera virtutis: ubi
1. Amor & benevolentia erga subditos & milites. Exaggerentur comparatione Diocletiani, Maximiniani, Galerii, Maximini, Maxentii tyrannorum eo tempore. Illustretur ex loco communi de amore subditorum.

page.notes: Catchword "z. For-" reads as printed at the foot right. Line "I. Genus" and following are list-like lines of the Tractatio, kept as lines. Some words in the faint text are uncertain; none flagged here beyond the main text as read.
